annotations.title: Google Ads ad schedule + device / location / hour bid adjustments

description: WHEN a Google Ads campaign runs and how much more or less it bids by device, location and hour. Pass only campaignId to read the current schedule and adjustments. schedule:[{day: MONDAY…SUNDAY | WEEKDAYS | WEEKENDS | EVERYDAY, start:"09:00", end:"17:00", bidModifier?}] REPLACES the schedule (scheduleMode:"add" appends; clearSchedule:true runs it all day again); account time zone, quarter hours, end may be 24:00. devices {mobile, desktop, tablet, connectedTv} and adGroupDevices (with adGroupId) take MULTIPLIERS: 1.2 = +20%, 0.8 = -20%, 0 = never show on that device. locations:[{geoTargetId, bidModifier}] adjusts locations the campaign already targets. On a LIVE campaign a change that can raise spend (more hours, a higher multiplier) needs confirm:true after the user approves; lowering never does. dryRun:true validates only. Read back from Google.

connectedTv.description: ad group bid multiplier for connected TV; needs adGroupId; 0 = never show

desktop.description: ad group bid multiplier for desktop; needs adGroupId; 0 = never show

mobile.description: ad group bid multiplier for mobile; needs adGroupId; 0 = never show

tablet.description: ad group bid multiplier for tablets; needs adGroupId; 0 = never show

clearSchedule.description: remove the schedule so it runs all day

confirm.description: true only after the user approved a change to a LIVE campaign or a delete

customerId.description: omit to use the selected default account

connectedTv.description: campaign bid multiplier for connected TV; 1.2 = +20%, 0 = never show there

desktop.description: campaign bid multiplier for desktop; 1.2 = +20%, 0 = never show on desktop

mobile.description: campaign bid multiplier for mobile; 1.2 = +20%, 0 = never show on mobile

tablet.description: campaign bid multiplier for tablets; 1.2 = +20%, 0 = never show on tablets

locations.description: bid adjustments for locations the campaign already targets

geoTargetId.description: Google geo target id, from find_google_ads_locations

loginCustomerId.description: manager id if operating through an MCC

schedule.description: ad schedule slots; replaces the current schedule unless scheduleMode is add

day.description: MONDAY to SUNDAY, WEEKDAYS, WEEKENDS or EVERYDAY

end.description: end time HH:MM in the account time zone; 24:00 allowed

start.description: start time HH:MM in the account time zone, quarter hours, e.g. 09:00

scheduleMode.description: replace (default) or add to the current schedule

name: set_google_ads_schedule_and_bids
